description: This file defines a header for cache-related functions in a project involving LZMA compressed kernel loader for Atheros AR7XXX/AR9XXX boards. It declares a single function 'flush_cache' intended to flush cache lines over a specified address range.

methods.name: flush_cache
methods.description: Flushes the CPU cache over a specified memory range starting at 'start_addr' for 'size' bytes.
